lines.text: Job asks how a mortal can be righteous before God, who is wise in heart and mighty in strength.
God moves mountains, shakes the earth, seals off the stars, and made the Bear, Orion and the Pleiades.
Job says that even if he washed with snow and lye, God would plunge him into the pit.
Job says God's hands shaped him, and he asks God to remember that He molded him like iron.
Job says his days are few and asks God to draw near to him so he may have comfort.
